exposure: serum 25(OH)D3 levels (low level <30 ng/mL vs normal level >=30 ng/mL)
cohort: 210 patients with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) from the Third Hospital of Xi'an between January 2022 and January 2024.
finding: Low serum 25(OH)D3 levels were an independent predictor of GDM occurrence and were significantly associated with a higher incidence of GDM, elevated FBG levels, and adverse pregnancy outcomes including gestational hypertension, fetal distress, cesarean section, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Low 25(OH)D3 levels were significantly associated with an increased incidence of cesarean section.
